trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn. It pops on its own the moment the other 54 are done, so there is nothing extra to do for it. No online play and no DLC are needed, and the whole run takes roughly 200 hours, most of it on the 100% completion checklist.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1, so it will be one of the first trophies on your list.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when Chapter 1 ends, right as the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when Chapter 2 ends, as the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, starts.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks once Chapter 3 is done, after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when Chapter 4 wraps up with its final mission, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the game's final mission in Chapter 5, after Operation Savage Glory. Once it pops, the whole map stays open for cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run, just by playing through the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist, just by playing through the story.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play, just by playing through the story.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 mission Headliners, just by playing through the story.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown, just by playing through the story.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory, just by playing through the story.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The long one. After the story, the checklist appears at Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it can be missed. It is far more forgiving than it sounds, closer to 60% true completion: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, and 15 of 18 card sets, meditations and other collectibles. Only the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's hunts must be done in full. Do optional missions as they appear and scan every new vehicle and animal you meet, and the list will shrink on its own.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the game's 397 stunts, mixing the four types however you like: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps. The under-the-bridge runs are the quickest to rack up. Track your progress by region at Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and note that the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so this one lands on the way there.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts nine activity types, which you can check at Progress, then Activities: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or drone race, and performing a stunt. The story introduces most of them, and the rest show up as blue dumbbell icons when you unfog the map. You will almost certainly finish this without trying while chasing the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges spread across 12 ranges, and every one of them needs a gold medal. The gold scores are not harsh, and the ranges also level up your Focus, which helps with Gunslinger. The 100% checklist requires all of them too, so this is not extra work on top of the platinum.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations with 42 races between them, and you need a win at every location. The 100% checklist requires all of the drone races as well, so treat this as part of that grind rather than a separate job.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations around Leonida. Each location counts once, so spread your wins around instead of repeating the same easy course. Car races, race challenges and drone races all feed the activity tracker, but only the 40 race locations count here.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Some time after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he sends a text that marks a fishing spot with a purple icon west of Key Lento. Go there and take him on in the fishing challenge. Win it and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: There are four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, all playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers, plus Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines out in the world. Pick any one you like and finish all of its levels at least once. You do not need to beat every challenge inside it, just reach the end. The home games are available from Chapter 1, though some story sections block them for a while.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3. While playing as Lucia you will get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address, which marks the questline in Belville. Finish her five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline gets marked in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams where you work for him. He calls you, then shows up as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at shipwrecks: he marks purple chest icons on the map, you find the treasure on the ocean floor with the metal detector and bring it back. Seven shipwrecks in total. Track it at Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees. He goes quiet for a stretch in Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2 and 3, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his five quests in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only certain stranger questlines count toward this one, and the game does not label which. Confirmed counters so far: Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle's McKittrick Farm jobs, Yago's street racing strand, and Pilot Pete's delivery runs. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. More qualifying strangers are still being confirmed by the community, so check the cited guide for the latest list before you plan your eight. Every strand stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City, marked by a green RK icon. Track the list at Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. He marks some cars in fixed spots, but you can also steal any of them off the street; scanning a sports car with the WAiNK app tells you if it is on the list, and east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach is full of them. Delivering a car in good condition pays more. The list stays open after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and gets marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers for Synthetic Labs appear around Vice City: go to them and destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone hands you his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down for good, and finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating at one spot with both Lucia and Jason counts twice. Track them at Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. This is the one trophy that might be missable: the first meditation happens at Jason's house in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her out to the balcony, and accept when she offers to show you how to meditate. It raises your counter by one, but it is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the others, so it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy. Do it anyway to be safe. The last meditation cannot be done until you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and starts some time after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when he texts you about his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He marks hunting spots with purple icons, you hunt the animal he asks for and bring it back to him. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest, which you can pick up again from any weapon locker at an Ammu-Nation. A clean one-shot kill keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required. Track the hunts at Map, then Activities, then Target Deck: there are 15 Target Decks, and all 15 are needed for 100% completion. It is still unconfirmed exactly which animal pops this trophy, so work through the decks and it will come.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: There are 18 collectible card sets hidden around Leonida, and you need any three of them complete for this trophy. The 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18, so this one lands early on the way to the bigger goal. Cards are found in the open world and in story buildings, and the cited guide maps every set.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK scans are things in the world you scan by holding Up and then R1: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags. There are well over 100 of them, and any 100 count, so just scan whatever you pass while exploring. The 100% checklist wants 100 WAiNK locations too, so this trophy and that checklist box fall together.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: There are 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, and you only need any 50 for this trophy. The 100% checklist wants 70, so this one pops on the way. Track them at Progress, then Challenges, and check the completed mark in the bottom right as you scroll. Most of them finish naturally while you work on everything else, so leave this for late and then pick the easiest ones you have left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam with your partner. Call them with Right plus Triangle, then build a 4-star wanted level by causing trouble, and escape the red heat zone. The cleanest escape is a fast sports bike through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: the cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone, not when you leave the flashing search area. It also comes on its own during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, since the big bank vault robberies there always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Also needs Coffee Break done first so you can bring your partner along. Call them with Right plus Triangle, then rob three robbery targets in a row while the police chase you the whole time. The trick is to stay in the flashing red and blue wanted state and never let it drop to the solid red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each, and crack the back-room safe with a sticky bomb. The pop is delayed about half a minute after you leave the third shop, and if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop and keep going.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: The game has 557 vehicles at launch, and you only need to discover 100 of them. Open the WAiNK app on your phone, or hold Up to use it instantly, then look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Scanning is enough, you never have to drive the car. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy arrives on the way there. Check your totals at Progress, then Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3 plus R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and weak spots light up, draining the purple focus bar under your health. You have to drop five enemies in one use, and it only lasts a few seconds. Set it up first: raise your focus by eating, drinking, or washing your face and showering at home, and pop Adrenaline to stretch the slowdown. Then line up five enemies at a gang operation, wear body armor so you can step out of cover, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has four levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets much easier late in the game and may pop on its own.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the big passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport. It has to be a plane connected to a boarding bridge, not one parked out on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence onto the airfield, head straight for the plane, and take the stairs next to the boarding bridge, which lead through a door right into the plane. Go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane back to the strip, take off, and fly at least 1 km away from the airport. The pop is delayed until you are that far out. Walking in through the terminal works too, but the airfield route is faster.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive in through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and start shooting enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons on the map. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun, never kick it, or the alarm goes off. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and switch off the alarm. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City. The trophy pops shortly after you walk out.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, marked automatically from story progress. It teaches the whole routine: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, wait for the guard to carry a briefcase of cash inside and open the vault, then slip in fast and rob it. Bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the cash alone, and hand off a bag with Right. After that mission you can pay Yasmani $10,000 a tip to mark more security vans with purple icons, once you have done his earlier quests. There are 8 large bank jobs in total: this trophy needs any 5, the 100% checklist needs all 8. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle, then swap to another car to stop being recognized. A single bank can pay up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The easiest way is the same mission that opens the bank vaults: That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4. Robbing a large bank vault there counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank first. You can also get it earlier on your own: find an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests, and Yasmani becomes your fence after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Unfog the entire map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the whole map turns visible. There are 52 areas to uncover, and the cited guide has a plane route that covers them all in one sweep.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations between them. For this trophy you only need one operation from each gang, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so it will pop on the way. Operations show as yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically as the story progresses. Track your count per gang at Progress, then Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar. That is the whole trophy.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, to hack into the car. Once inside, drive forward and straight through the glass. The pop is slightly delayed and fires once you are further down the street. Only this blue Banshee counts, not any other car: it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office, which you blow open with sticky bombs, so buy some at an Ammu-Nation first. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and you do not need to kill anyone. If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a while, so you can go back and grab what is left: nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two characters. Buy a fitness club membership and work out, always bringing your partner along with Right plus Triangle: while you train with one character, the other finishes their training automatically, so you make double progress. Find clubs by filtering Map, then Activities. You can check strength at Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Strength, and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn the notifications on first at Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile: a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. The profile runs from Professional, for stealthy objectives and clean escapes, through Hardened and Violent, to Psycho and finally Irredeemable, which is permanent and best avoided since the police get far more aggressive. You will almost certainly reach 500 naturally while doing robberies and the 100% checklist. If you are still short at the end, the fastest farm is running over civilians and police with a car, but keep the Irredeemable warning in mind.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Unconfirmed. No guide has a verified method for this trophy yet. The current best guess is that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific way; the store sits in Little Cuba, Vice City. Do not chase an unverified method: wait for the community to confirm it, and check the cited guide again before you try anything.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside. If it is there, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Walk toward it and it drops a woman it abducted: talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is random and not guaranteed, so if the car is not there, drive away and come back later.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick ten pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded areas work best, like Vice City or Ocean Beach, where you will not have to hunt for targets.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, meeting Raul's crew, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence: Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all robberies, not in one trip. It comes naturally while doing robberies for the 100% checklist, and a single bank vault can hand you up to $205,000 at once.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. There is no shortage of places to spend it: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages, which cost $160,000 in total. They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when you steal the Crawler for Moses: you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through it. Four more garages come from the story and do not count. The fastest money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, where you take a vehicle to Moses. It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered wherever you are. You need enough garage space first, so buy garages as in Little Boxes: each garage adds one or more parking spots. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and then Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
